data.one_liner: A Dart timer implementation that can be paused, resumed, and reset.
data.what_it_does: Provides a timer class that tracks elapsed time and can be paused, resumed, reset, or run periodically. It exposes state flags like isPaused, isExpired, and isCancelled.
use_when: You need a timer that can be temporarily paused and later resumed without losing elapsed progress
You require periodic timers with pause and reset capabilities
avoid_when: Standard Dart Timer functionality is entirely sufficient for your use case
strengths: Supports pause, resume, reset, and cancel operations
Provides periodic timer support via PausableTimer.periodic
weaknesses: Maintains an imperative state model that must be managed manually
